pack.name: Wellness Minimalist
pack.description: High-end editorial aesthetics for luxury skincare and wellness brands. Features earthy stone textures, lush botanicals, and high-tech clinical vibes inspired by top global brands like Aesop and Augustinus Bader.

templates.title: Wellness - Earthy Stone
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo for a luxury skincare brand. A minimalist amber glass bottle sitting on a raw, textured sandstone block. Soft, natural morning side-lighting creating long shadows. The palette is muted earthy tones, beige, and sage green. Professional studio quality, 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Wellness - Botanical Lush
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo of a luxury organic serum bottle nestled among vibrant, deep green heirloom tomato vines and lush basil leaves. Bright, high-contrast afternoon sunlight. The palette is rich forest green, deep red, and gold. Flamingo Estate aesthetic. Professional studio quality, 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Wellness - Tech Clinical
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo of a sleek cobalt blue skincare jar with a copper lid, sitting on a mirrored surface with gentle water ripples. Sharp, clinical laboratory-style lighting. High-tech luxury aesthetic, Augustinus Bader style. The palette is royal blue, copper, and crisp white. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Wellness - Ethereal Skin
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic close-up editorial photo of a stunning Black woman's face with glowing, hydrated skin. She is in a minimalist spa setting with warm grey stone and soft steam in the background. Extremely high detail on skin texture and water droplets. Soft, ethereal lighting. 4:5 aspect ratio.
